invariants.rationale: The method returns a newly constructed TableWriteStats object, so result is never null.
The result's stats are built from mapping each WriteStatus in writeMetadata to its stat, preserving size.
The method collects non-null stats from each WriteStatus in writeMetadata, so all elements should be non-null.
The method assumes writeMetadata contains only non-null WriteStatus objects for mapping.
All stats from WriteStatus are directly collected and put into result's stats list.
